operator_scope: No cover or paper TOC; native body and back contact retained; local review, publication candidate.

rows.old_statement: Cover (p1), paper TOC (p3), back cover (p22), printed page numbers and the EN language badge beside IMPORTANT are not on the Web (`web_exclusions`).
rows.resolution: Front cover p1 and paper TOC p3 excluded by explicit user scope. EN at IMPORTANT and own back contact/QR restored.

rows.old_statement: The print's two-column safety, FCC and warranty pages flow in one column; column breaks are not kept.
rows.resolution: Safety and operating source columns restored with exact item boundary. FCC retains own p6 two-column split within interference sentence; ISED licence/RF two columns restored. Warranty has only years two columns, other clauses full-width.

rows.old_statement: Chapter title strips, ● subsection titles and bold lead-in labels use the shared h2/h3/h4 headings.
rows.resolution: Plain SAVE THESE INSTRUCTIONS/GROUNDING/Emergency leads preserved; full-width operating/maintenance pills, compact EN/IMPORTANT, dotted subsection marks once, original specification subgroup size restored.

rows.old_statement: The top WARNING strip and the WARNING precaution box on p4, the grounding WARNING, the DANGER box and every CAUTION/NOTE/WARNING side box use the shared `HB-CALLOUT-STRIP` callout; the shared signal triangle replaces the print's per-box glyph.
rows.resolution: Own source p4 warning and p5 danger outlines/glyphs retain native text overlays. Warning card only wraps title/lead; native bullet columns outside. Signal table triangle is own PDF glyph. Plain grounding WARNING retained.

rows.old_statement: Five operation/charging panels hold body copy inside the drawing (standby time box, prerequisite pills, footer notes, energy-saving instruction, LED mode line and steps, AC charging caption). That copy is removed from the panel art by vector strip and set as native text in the shared grey `hb-text-panel` or, for the three LED steps, an ordered list beside the remaining ①②③ icons.
rows.resolution: Native copy restored within own original power/AC/DC/LED/energy/charging panel positions. Original source frames and leader art retained, own Red Cross product artwork used throughout.

rows.old_statement: The LCD SCREEN mode table and its button art use the shared `HB-TABLE-LCD-MODE`; the KEY COMBINATIONS table uses `HB-TABLE-KEY-COMBINATIONS`, whose shared 44rem minimum width scrolls inside the component (also at 1280 px in the 46rem reading column).
rows.resolution: LCD mode original art/table near-equal desktop widths; key combinations own button crops, four source clocks and four pluses. Desktop min-width removed, phone table internal pan retained.

rows.old_statement: The two Symbol/Meaning pictogram tables use one `HB-TABLE-SYMBOL-ICON` with two panels (4 + 3 rows); the signal-word table shows the shared triangle on every badge.
rows.resolution: Signal/native meaning table and original own triangle retained; own two-panel 4+3 pictogram table unchanged.

rows.old_statement: Specification groups use the shared `HB-TABLE-SPEC` section strips; numbered troubleshooting steps show one step per line.
rows.resolution: Own specification values unchanged, USB-C shared label with source two value rows; four native dotted subgroup headings; F7 solar condition preserved and V_oc rendered subscript.

rows.old_statement: The ISED / RF exposure panel uses the shared grey `hb-text-panel`; the FCC panel keeps a navigation-only "FCC" title hidden by the shared FCC style, as every published FCC section does.
rows.resolution: Own p6 ISED and RF columns restored. FCC original paragraph breaks and source mark wrapping restored within existing shared FCC ComponentSpec; own FCC RF heading separate from MODIFICATION.

rows.old_statement: Leader labels, button silk, step numbers and screenshot captions stay in the complete source panels; they are listed in `transcription.json` (`fig.*`) and bound to each figure's alt text and IR `embedded_labels`.
rows.resolution: All panel labels, silk, leader lines and screenshots use this exact RC PDF. Copy removed only where restored as native positioned text; figure labels remain transcript/IR-bound. Right product view full outline restored.
